title: Why Has the Eye Evolved from Scratch at Least 40 Times?
question: If evolution has no foresight and no plan, why do wildly unrelated lineages keep independently inventing the same complex solutions, like the eye, over and over again?
summary: Octopuses, insects, vertebrates, and jellyfish all evolved eyes independently, along dozens of separate paths, suggesting evolution is not purely random but is channeled by deep physical and mathematical constraints.
